metadata.title: Gromov--Hausdorff Distance Between Euclidean Unit Balls
metadata.abstract: What is the Gromov--Hausdorff distance between Euclidean unit balls of different dimensions, denoted by $d_\gh(B^m,B^n)$, for $m>n$? Note that the lower bound coming from the stability of persistent homology is zero, since all balls possess identical (trivial) persistent homology. To establish non-trivial lower bounds, we exploit the Borsuk--Ulam theorem. For any $n \ge 1$, we prove that $d_\gh(B^m,B^n)\ge \frac{\sqrt{n+1}}{\sqrt{n+1}+\sqrt{n}} > \frac{1}{2}$ for $m>n$, and that $d_\gh(B^m,B^n)\to 1$ as $m\to \infty$. Finally, we prove that $d_\gh(B^m,B^n)<1$ for all finite $m>n\geq 1$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对不同维欧氏单位球的 GH 距离给出显式正下界，并研究高维及有限维极限。
analysis.breakthrough: 在持久同调给不出下界时提供维数敏感障碍，固定低维时距离趋于 1。
analysis.limitations: 不等于求出所有维数组合的精确距离。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 声明 ChatGPT 辅助附录 A 中两个引理的证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 直接服务度量比较，拓扑障碍方法具有良好复用潜力。
